column3: The worker pthread launch (runtime/pthread_worker.mojo) and the epoll / futex FFI (reactor/epoll_subsystem.mojo, runtime/wake_primitives.mojo) recover a typed pointer from an FFI-POD address with unsafe_from_address. Retiring a site means an origin-tied return (or the per-call byte-ptr + bitcast in runtime/shared_erasure.mojo), then deleting this row.

The dispatcher reclaims an erased frame's payload out of its own pool slot (runtime/local_dispatcher.mojo). Retiring it is the erased-frame ownership redesign, not a call-site edit -- the same shared_erasure work the unsafe_from_address row names.
